title: Refute: find signals, try to kill them, keep what survives
description:
Refute is an open-source framework where agents try to break scientific claims before anyone believes them. Claims are pre-registered and locked with SHA-256 hashes, attacked by deterministic falsification tests and a blind holdout, and reported in reproducible evidence dossiers. Agents propose; deterministic tests decide. A claim is never proven: it only survives, or it does not.

Refute reports verdicts only, never a new planet, and its methods are labelled method_status: not_validated. What each phase tested, its verdict and its declared limits are recorded in the repository: the phase history in https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md and the current phase in https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/main/ROADMAP.md. The v0.4 pilot's dossiers are in https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23898648 and its reproduction inputs in https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23874043.
notes: The license field names the license of the code (Apache-2.0). It does not cover the third-party data files in the repository: each keeps its own terms, stated with their sources in the DATA_LICENSE records of this release: https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/calibration/DATA_LICENSE.md, https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/calibration/v0.2/eb_snapshot/DATA_LICENSE.md, https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/calibration/v0.4/DATA_LICENSE.md, https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/calibration/v0.4/DATA_LICENSE-addendum-2026-11-06.md and https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/calibration/v0.5/DATA_LICENSE.md. Every third-party data file, with the record that covers it, is listed in https://github.com/klucilla/refute/blob/v0.5.0/docs/third-party-data.md. No single license covers the archive as a whole.
